resources.string: Default: 1. A value of 0.1 bills 10% of the base cost. Applied once to the subtotal for token and per-request billing.

Each metric uses its own valid samples, with no minimum count. P95 is item ⌈0.95 × sample count⌉ after sorting. TPS averages output tokens ÷ (total duration − first-token latency) for successful requests. Missing historical fields are excluded from the relevant metric.
Successful usage: %1$s complete · %2$s without usable splits
